content.text:
Changes made to `0.html`:

- `aria-current="true"` → `aria-current="page"` (correct ARIA value for nav highlighting, also fixed in JS and CSS selector)
- Added `<link rel="canonical">` and a real inline-SVG favicon instead of the empty `data:,` placeholder
- Multiple-intersecting-sections edge case: now picks the section with highest intersection ratio, and sets an initial active link as a fallback when `IntersectionObserver` isn't supported

The placeholder copy ("My Page", `hello@example.com`, canonical URL) is still generic — let me know if you want me to fill in real content/branding.
